Violation: Drunken driving for four-wheelers in Chhattisgarh
Relevant Law / Section: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Section 185
Penalty: For the first offence, imprisonment up to 6 months and/or fine up to Rs. 10,000. For the second or subsequent offence, imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine up to Rs. 15,000.
Enforcement Action: Possible imprisonment and/or fines. Disqualification of driving license may also apply.
Short Explanation: Driving a motor vehicle while under the influence of alcohol above the prescribed limit is illegal. The penalty is more severe for repeated offences.
